notes.title: Itch.io release and more controls options
notes.content:
[h2]Hello fellow boomerang throwers![/h2]

[h3][b]Itch.io release is probably happening later today![/b][/h3]
EDIT: Due to some ridiculous technical difficulties the itch release will happen tomorrow.

It's not up yet, but you'll be able to find it here: https://gianaras.itch.io/cosmic-pebble



There is also a small update with a few quality of life changes:

[list]
[*] Added a new submenu: Options>Controls>General.
[*] Moved "invert sprint" option to from general gameplay options to general controls options.
[*] Added new general controls option "Mouse aiming", which is on by default. Turning this off will remove and ignore the mouse cursor (during gameplay only), and make the aiming function like on controller. If you turn this off, make sure all direction bindings are set for keyboard (up is not bound to anything by default!). Keep in mind that you can still bind the mouse buttons to actions (for example, you can still throw with the left click), the only thing that changes is how the aiming itself functions.
[*] Added new general controls option "Allow right stick aiming", which is off by default. Before you could always use the right stick to aim on controller, but now because it's so awful, if you're a weird person and want to use it, you have to go out of your way to enable this option. This mainly exists to not tempt new players to use the right stick (sorry Mr Dets).
[*] Made background clouds slightly more prominent.
[/list]

That's all folks!

notes.title: Lower price and the reason behind it
notes.content:
[h2]📡 Quick Announcement Everyone! 📡[/h2]

Thank you to everyone checking out the game in this first week since release! Extra thank you to all the lovely active members of the community on the server, I've been having a ton of fun!

Some of you may have noticed that the [b]price [/b]of the game was halved a day ago from 10 USD to [b]5 USD[/b]. The TL;DR of why I did this is mainly from watching the stats behind the scenes and from gathering feedback. It seems that for what the game appears to be on the store page, the price was way too much, so I decided to change it now while it's early so that more people get the chance to play. If you want more details you can read [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/gamedev/comments/1eez40f/i_released_my_first_game_and_i_feel_mixed/]this reddit post[/url] from me, but keep in mind it's a bit more negative sounding than what I actually feel right now (especially after the post I feel really good generally speaking, in part due to you guys).

I sincerely want to [b]apologize [/b]to anyone that bought the game at its full price. It looks awful changing the price so suddenly from one day to another, and I completely understand if you feel scammed. I give you my word this was never my intention, and again I want to deeply apologize. I just think that reducing the price is the best thing I could have done for the game. Again, for more context, please read the reddit post. If you can still refund, feel free to do so.

Regardless, thank you so much for supporting the game. I want to try to give an exclusive [b]in-game reward[/b] of some sort to the people that bought the game early on, but I'm still coming up with ideas.

[h3]For the rest of you, [b]now the game costs less than 5 USD and the 10% discount is still up for ~2 hours[/b], so if you were on the fence before, this is a great opportunity to jump in![/h3]



Again the reddit post title is a bit baity on purpose, I don't actually feel mixed I'm quite happy actually!

Also, I'll try to release the game on itch soon, and the linux build should be up and hopefully stable, although likely not as good as before performance-wise.

notes.title: 6 Month Catch-Up (Sorry 😁)
notes.content:
...Yeah... sorry for going radio silent for so long!

Luckily, I've been hard at work over the past months, making sure the game is as good as it can be before release. I also plan to release a youtube video soon talking in depth about all my progress and future plans and events, but I'll give you a short briefing here as well.

THINGS THAT I'VE DONE:
- Optional story dialogue
- Major reworks to two levels of the game
- Boss reworks
- Immeasurable amounts of level design across the entire game
- Complete rework of gamepad controls (game will be 100% playable with gamepad with no issues)
- New character portraits for Sophia the astronaut
- Assist options that should offer an enjoyable experience to almost everyone
- Updated visuals throughout the entire game
- Tons of bug fixing and polishing

WHAT'S LEFT:
- Marketing
- More polishing
- Attempt to port game to Mac and Linux
- If I get the chance, some end game secrets 👀

WHEN WILL IT COME OUT:
I'm pretty sure I've found the release day/release window, hopefully I'll also have a release date trailer out at some point so I can reveal it! But it will be released in the summer! Surely! Stay tuned for the release date.

STEAM NEXT FEST:
The game will be featured in the next fest from June 10th to June 17th. I have plans to hold a speedrunning contest (winners will get a free copy of the game and probably some exclusive in-game cosmetic!) during this time and maybe schedule some steam livestreams as well. I hope to see you there as well!

That's all for now. Expect more videos, a trailer, a release date, and the steam next fest stuff soon!
Hope you have a great rest of your day.

Also, here's a link to the game's discord in case you'd like to join:
https://discord.gg/6JBKE9cwMN

notes.title: Gamepad controls update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Yesterday I pushed an update for the [b]demo[/b] of the game that addresses a lot of the issues with the gamepad controls.

Using the right stick is still possible, but now you can just use (X)/(square) by default on your gamepad to throw the boomerang in front of you, and angle upwards or downwards with up/down. I also cranked the aim assist up to eleven. From testing it works pretty well, and since a lot of people suggested aiming with the movement buttons to begin with, I hope this solves most of the issues.

Also, if you've already played the demo I suggest going to the controls options and click on the restore defaults button to avoid confusion.

I've also added a disclaimer at the start that low-key recommends keyboard and mouse, because these changes make the game way easier with controller. That being said, if you want a more casual experience, controller is likely the way to go.

It's on my to-do to add an invert-sprint option as well.


Thanks to everybody for your patience, have a nice day!

notes.title: Hello! Game status and release plans.
notes.content:
Hello! I'm Giannis (the guy). I thought I'd try using this announcement thing, so I'll quickly talk about the state of the game and my release plans.

I just finished the story finale. This means that the game is essentially content complete. All that's left is marketing (oh no), polish, bug fixes, etc, which include:

[list]
[*] optional dialogue
[*] better UI
[*] rework of the hub area
[*] steam features like achievements and leaderboards
[*] maybe making the soundtrack dynamic
[/list]

How long will this take? I don't know, but I'm hoping these will be done by the end of the year.
Will I release this year? Probably not. I could probably do it, but I don't want to rush.
The current vision is releasing early next year, as early as I can.

Since I'm done with the game's content, I'll start uploading videos on youtube as well, to try to get some eyes on the game. I'll try to occasionally post here too. The store page needs an update as well.

I also have a discord server for playtesters but it's not public yet. Stay tuned for that.

Thank you for listening to my TED talk. Have a good one. o7
